body: New item from audit B-61 (proven on an emulator, 6 Nov 2026): the pull (encore_writer.dart applyPlaylists, lines 153-185) writes the server's playlist name and un-deletes without looking at the outbox; only likes, saved albums and follows are protected (pending_intent.dart). The rename on the phone was undone on screen at 40 s and redone at 68 s. Details and acceptance in docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md section P2-28.
